title: Meaning and the Reader
text:
Literary criticism asks how a text creates meaning. Structuralist critics examine the underlying systems of language that shape a story. Post-structuralists, by contrast, argue that a text never settles on a single interpretation. For them, meaning is always deferred and open to revision. This tension remains central to modern scholarship.

Consider a reader who opens a novel from the nineteenth century. The author's intentions may be recovered from letters and diaries. Yet the reader's own historical moment also shapes what the book seems to say. Therefore, many critics now treat interpretation as a dialogue rather than a verdict. This view has made the reader a co-creator of the text.

questions.text: According to the passage, what do structuralist critics examine?
options: The underlying systems of language that shape a story
The author's private letters and diaries
The historical moment in which a reader lives
The single interpretation a text is given

questions.text: What may be recovered from letters and diaries, according to the passage?
What does the passage suggest about the post-structuralist view of meaning?
options: Meaning is fixed once the author finishes writing
Meaning remains permanently open to new readings
Meaning can only be found in historical documents
Meaning belongs entirely to the critic

questions.text: Why does the passage describe the reader as a co-creator of the text?
options: Because readers rewrite the author's original words
Because the reader's context helps shape what a text seems to mean
Because critics always agree with readers
Because diaries are more important than novels

vocabulary.definition: an explanation of what something means
a change made to something after it has been reviewed
a conversation or exchange of ideas between people

paragraph_translations: Літературна критика ставить питання про те, як текст створює значення. Структуралістські критики досліджують приховані системи мови, які формують історію. Постструктуралісти, навпаки, стверджують, що текст ніколи не має єдиного тлумачення. Для них значення завжди відкладене і відкрите для перегляду. Ця напруга залишається центральною для сучасної науки.

Розгляньмо читача, який відкриває роман дев'ятнадцятого століття. Наміри автора можна відновити за листами та щоденниками. Проте історичний момент самого читача також формує те, що книга, здається, говорить. Тому багато критиків тепер розглядають інтерпретацію як діалог, а не як вирок. Ця думка перетворила читача на співтворця тексту.
